name: AcceptReconciliationProposal
transaction_boundary: one short outer LLD-01 UnitOfWork shared with exactly one owning-domain mutation service and required participants
guards: recovery run has latest exact authorized review

for sr_source_disappearance_review: current LLD-03 source_presence_base_token equals proposal base_state_token_sha256 and SrSourcePresenceEvidenceProvider validates the exact proposal/import_run/prior_source_observation/target SR population-absence evidence

for every WFM proposal: recompute the exact LLD-05 SOMA_WFM_IMPORT_BASE_V1 token for that proposal kind inside this same writer UnitOfWork and exact-compare proposal base_state_token_sha256 before receipt
proposal kind resolves to one static owner service
idempotency: COMMAND_ENVELOPE_V1 binding proposal id/revision/fingerprint/base token and material reason
receipt_order: authoritative revalidation/no-change -> insert one receipt -> owner/participant writes -> LLD-04 disposition/proposal/counter writes -> audits/results -> commit
mutations: exact LLD-03 or LLD-05 owner writes; LLD-02/06 only through declared participants
disappearance_acceptance: sr_source_disappearance_review dispatches only to LLD-03 ServiceRequestImportMutationService.apply_source_disappearance_review after the exact presence-token/provider guards. After the one outer receipt exists, the owner appends one disappearance_reviewed event and its registered LLD-03 audit/result evidence; then LLD-04 records the accepted disposition/run counters in the same UoW. Reject/Defer/Supersede append no LLD-03 warning event. Any owner/provider failure rolls back the receipt/event/audit/result and leaves no accepted disposition.

wfm_acceptance_contract.common: WFM acceptance evidence_mode is observed_row from source_family=wfm_service_provider with identity_state=valid, entity_kind=wfm, canonical_primary_id exact TK+14 and canonical_parent_rfc_no exact NC+14. LLD-04 re-reads that immutable observation plus ordered proposal changes and never trusts copied UI/request values. The proposal fingerprint continues to bind immutable source evidence/change rows/profile ids; the independently recomputed LLD-05 SOMA_WFM_IMPORT_BASE_V1 digest binds owner state.
wfm_acceptance_contract.wfm_create_or_adopt: target_kind=wfm; target_business_id equals observation canonical_primary_id. LLD-05 task_no_status RETIRED is blocked and cannot reach acceptance. ABSENT requires target_internal_id null and exactly one ordinal-0 change {field_key:'task_no',change_kind:'create',value_kind:'identity',before:null,after:canonical task_no,source_observation_field_id:null}. ACTIVE requires target_internal_id equal the exact current Task id and the same shape with change_kind='adopt'; adoption is valid only for that exact canonical WFM identity/current parent review context. canonical_parent_rfc_no is resolved through current LLD-03 exact RFC identity at acceptance; no fuzzy/suffix adoption. The accepted owner input includes source lifecycle classification derived only from the same observation for RFC-eligibility gating; it is not persisted by create/adopt. Dispatch only to LLD-05 create_or_adopt_wfm_from_source. This mutation creates/adopts identity/assignment only and never accepts provider source projection, operational plan, execution/outcome or Objective membership.
wfm_acceptance_contract.wfm_source_projection: target_kind=wfm; target_internal_id and target_business_id exact-match the current WFM identity. Ordered changes are nonempty, unique by field_key, and restricted to task_status,planned_start,planned_end because these are the exact accepted provider facts persisted by LLD-05 wfm_source_projection_cache; every workbook-backed change binds a source_observation_field_id owned by the same proposal observation. dispatch_progress,rep_office,risk_level,task_name,description remain immutable LLD-04 source evidence and are not copied into LLD-05 projection storage; rfc_status and customer_organization are likewise excluded because they belong to LLD-03/reference-review authority. The owner DTO is reconstructed from immutable observation evidence, never generic after_text: provider_status_token/provider_lifecycle_class follow the closed WFM status vocabulary and non-destructive unknown/blank semantics; both usable valid plan endpoints set exact UTC whole seconds, both validated blank endpoints set unscheduled provider plan, and incomplete/malformed plan evidence cannot clear prior accepted source-plan truth. accepted_source_observation_id is the exact proposal observation. Dispatch only to LLD-05 apply_wfm_source_projection. Provider Complete/Plan Cancel may create/supersede pending source-terminal review in that same UoW but never directly creates Task execution/outcome/Objective membership.
wfm_acceptance_contract.wfm_plan_reconciliation: target_kind=task_plan; target_internal_id and target_business_id exact-match the current WFM Task. The exact currently accepted LLD-05 source projection must be the reviewed source observation/revision and must contain a complete nonnull source plan. Proposal changes are exactly two ordered instant changes: ordinal 0 field_key=planned_start and ordinal 1 field_key=planned_end, each change_kind='set', value_kind='instant', source_observation_field_id owned by the same accepted observation, after_integer equal to the exact accepted source-plan endpoint, and before_integer null iff no current operational plan else equal to its exact current endpoint. Unscheduled provider source plan never emits/accepts this kind because Beta 1.0 has no destructive operational-plan clear. Dispatch only to LLD-05 apply_reviewed_operational_plan_from_source. Owner revalidates Task/current plan/execution/Objective plan context/explicit locks, appends origin=wfm_source_adoption with exact source_observation_id, advances Task/current-plan revisions once, preserves Objective membership pin/envelope, and leaves regrouping to its separate reviewed workflow.

revision_effects: proposal/run increment exactly once when changed; owner revisions follow owner contract; source-presence event append does not fabricate an SR entity revision or source-field projection revision; NO_CHANGE increments none
post_commit_work: refresh projections only; RFC terminal cascade and Objective regrouping remain separate workflows. Source reappearance is not an acceptance follow-up: later successful Advanced Search publication schedules its own bounded durable reconciliation job.
